text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: metering-ingest-deadletter spike fired (P1) for service=metering-ingest env=prod targets=consumer-group-2 deadletter_count=1203 > threshold=500

incident-bot: Alert details: https://pd.company.com/alerts/P1-2178001234 : escalation to metering oncall

sara: acked. I'm on it. pulling logs and consumer lag now.

vikram: seeing a sudden error rate from transformer-consumer when processing older events, lots of deserialize failures. deadletter queue size jumped ~2x over 10m.

jamie: look for schema drift? had a rollout to websocket-ingest earlier today?

vikram: yeah there was a small ingest schema patch at 09:12 UTC but initial checks passed. I'll grep the deadletter examples.

kevin: tagging finance: possible invoice delay risk. If backfill doesn't finish we might need temporary invoice hold. @linda fyi

linda: noted. please post customer impact ASAP. ops team will assess billing holds.

sara: quick mitigation: scaling consumer-group-2 replicas + restart of transformer-consumer to clear transient bad state. Running command:

```
kubectl scale deployment transformer-consumer -n prod --replicas=6
kubectl rollout restart deployment/transformer-consumer -n prod
```

incident-bot: Command accepted by ops-bot, scaling started.

ops-bot: Scaling transformer-consumer from 3 -> 6. New pods 3/3 ready in ~40s.

vikram: deploying a hotfix to the deserializer to skip unknown optional fields and log payload hash. will push non-blocking patch to consumer. prepping canary.

jamie: while that lands, can we drain current deadletter queue into a quarantine S3 prefix for manual review to avoid re-processing bad messages into billing?

vikram: yes. running a safe drain job to s3://redwood-metering/quarantine/2178001234/ -- job id dq-drain-77

sara: drain started. ETA ~8m for current backlog snapshot.

kevin: any estimate on affected customers/invoices?

vikram: preliminary: ~4 customers show missing token counts in last 2 hours when comparing ingest vs ledger. totals: approx 2300 tokens unaccounted. Might affect invoice generation for 2 mid-market customers if not backfilled by EOD.

linda: escalate to finance ops. If backfill not complete, we may need to hold auto-invoicing for those customers. I'm standing by with contacts.

sara: canary patch applied to one replica, looks good. No new deserialize errors in canary logs for 6m. Rolling out to remainder.

ops-bot: rollout status: canary ok -> 5/6 replicas updated -> ready.

vikram: consumer error rate dropping, deadletter enqueue rate halved. Monitoring for 15m.

jamie: good. once drain finishes, run a reconciliation job to compute token deltas and generate backfill plan. Use low-rate replays to avoid overload.

sara: drain job completed. 1,210 messages quarantined. Starting reconciliation job: `reconcile-backfill --since 2177997600 --to 2178001200 --out=backfill-plan-2178001234.json`

ops-bot: Reconciliation job submitted. Job id recon-482, expected runtime 12m.

vikram: recon complete. Backfill plan indicates 1,150 tokens missing that map to two customers (cust-678, cust-912). Plan will replay with rate limit 50 req/s. Running backfill now.

kevin: notify sales and PMs for cust-678 and cust-912. I'll draft an internal note for support to prep client comms if invoices delay.

linda: please hold auto-invoice job for those two customers until backfill completes. Command run: `invoice-scheduler hold --customer=cust-678,cust-912 --reason=ingest-deadletter-backfill --until=ETA-1h`

sara: hold applied. invoice-scheduler: held 2 customers.

vikram: backfill running, rate=50 rps, estimated finish 14m. error rate zero so far.

jamie: timeline check: initial alert at 09:30, scaling and patch rolled by 09:38, drain done 09:46, backfill started 09:50. Good containment.

kevin: customer impact summary for ops brief: 2 customers with potential invoice delay, estimated max delay 1h if backfill completes on time. No wide outage, billing ingestion degraded for ~30-45m window, token delta ~~2300 but reconciled down to ~1150 post-quarantine.

linda: thanks. I'll coordinate external comms only if backfill fails.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert resolved (auto) - metering-ingest-deadletter spike subsided.

vikram: backfill finished successfully. Reconciliation confirms ledger matches ingest for the affected window. Closing loop.

sara: removing temporary holds: `invoice-scheduler release --customer=cust-678,cust-912` -> released.

kevin: sending summary to finance ops + stakeholders, and adding postmortem stub.

jamie: postmortem notes: root cause likely optional-field schema change + non-fail-safe deserializer. Action items: 1) stricter ingest schema validation + canary pipeline 2) deserializer tolerant-by-default + payload hashing 3) add metric for deadletter spike velocity 4) automate quarantine drain and backfill runbook.

linda: ack, will track finance comms item.

sara: oncall handoff: I'm handing to jamie for follow-ups and postmortem. jamie, you got it?

jamie: taking it. thanks all. closing thread when postmortem is created. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Thread closed (no active alerts).
